messages:
Nina L: Heads up — onboarding wizard is creating console SA tokens that show up as "unknown_project" in billing/telemetry. Found in per-route dashboard this morning.
Samir: repro steps?
Nina L: Steps: Console > Onboard app -> create SA via wizard -> Generate token. In /v1/introspect the `project` claim is null, telemetry pipeline tags as UNKNOWN.
Oliver: My guess: the console uses the proxy-exchange path which currently drops origin_project when the caller is `console-service` (we saw similar with cross-org exchange).
infra-bot: deploy log snippet: `exchange-service v2.14 token-mint request headers: {x-request-source:console, x-caller:console-service} -> minted_token.claims.project:null`
Anya: Proposal: add explicit origin_project claim at mint time and persist it. Also surface origin metadata in the console UI so users see attribution.
Raj: Security note — adding origin_project is fine but we must ensure the exchange verifies caller consent and record audit trail; don't want spoofed claims.
Samir: short-term mitigation: console client can attach an `X-Console-Origin: org:12345;proj:6789` header to the exchange request and exchange-service writes it to token.claims.origin.
Oliver: Agree. Also add a Kinesis audit event so we can backfill telemetry for the last 48 hours. Backfill will help explain quota anomalies.
Nina L: Impact: a few Dedicated customers reported quota punch-through yesterday — likely related. This explains why quota dashboards showed usage attributed to fallback buckets.
Anya: I'll prototype console client + exchange patch and add a feature flag so we can canary. Will also add a UI hint when attribution is missing.
Raj: Add e2e tests that validate: minted token contains `origin_project`, introspect returns same, telemetry pipeline tags correctly. Include threat-model review.
Samir: For telemetry pipeline we should fall back to key binding when claim missing, but only as opt-in fallback and flagged in logs so we can correct with backfill.
Nina L: Canary plan: enable on 5% of orgs tomorrow AM behind flag. @Anya please post PR + rollout steps when ready. :pray: 
Anya: Will do. Aiming for PR by EOD and will coordinate with SRE for canary monitoring.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-4821 to track backfill + exchange patch + telemetry changes.
Oliver: Also recommend console warning on token creation if attribution cannot be set (so users know it's limited).
Nina L: Thanks all — if canary shows no regressions we'll roll to 25% next day. Ping me if anything blocks.
